name: Veterans Electric LLC
old_description: Veterans Electric is a veteran owned and operated company with eight plus years working in the electrical industry.
about:
Veterans Electric LLC, operating as Veteran's Electric, is based in Lynchburg, Virginia. The company is veteran-owned and operated, founded by Jonathan Maldonado, a master electrician who began his electrical career at age 17 when he joined the military in 2013. Maldonado served a four-year commitment with the Army Corps of Engineers, gaining experience in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical work before establishing the business.

The firm provides electrical contracting services across residential, commercial, and generator installation segments. Residential work includes wiring, lighting upgrades, panel repairs, and smart-home installations. Commercial services cover new installations, system upgrades, and ongoing maintenance for businesses and properties. The company also installs backup generators for homes and businesses. The team reports more than 500 completed projects and offers 24/7 emergency support, with a core crew of four including a lead electrician, technician, operations manager, and installer.

Customers range from homeowners to commercial contractors and property managers. Notable projects include the electrical build-out for the Americas Home Place showroom on Timberlake Road and new-construction wiring for homes on Meadowbrook Lane in Rustburg. The company's background in industrial electrical work also positions it for light industrial clients.

Maldonado emphasizes a personal standard, treating every job as if it were his own house. The company promotes guaranteed quality, skilled professionals, and an experienced team, backed by upfront quotes and a typical scheduling window of 24–48 hours.
